asset.name: AccessGate
asset.description: The combined permission and feature gate handling loading, unavailable, upgrade-required, request-access, read-only, and hidden states without duplicating policy logic per surface.

rationale: Modelled as a component rather than a pattern so ordinary components can gate themselves. Read-only is the state usually forgotten: hiding a control the user can see the effects of is more confusing than showing it disabled with a reason.
